# VoDog research fork

Based on [BCP v1.1](https://github.com/chenxiaolong/BCP/tree/0350949cc1a8b83bebc725cf25256b259c61edf9), commit `0350949cc1a8b83bebc725cf25256b259c61edf9`, licensed under GPLv3.

The fork adds a host PCM bridge, privileged capture/injection, microphone foreground-service support and device-protected preferences. It is an optional research component, separate from the VoDog gateway. The source archive includes build files, GPL license, upstream documentation and generated test tones. `source-files.json` lists the delivered archive members and their SHA-256 checksums.
